meta_default: Verified beaches, forts, temples, stays and food on the Konkan coast — honest visitor verdicts, tide and monsoon status, and trip plans that work offline, in English, Hindi and Marathi.
meta_stays: Homestays, beachfront and orchard stays on the Konkan coast, checked by our team — with prices and where each price comes from.
meta_food: Where to eat on the Konkan coast: home-style kitchens and local legends serving Malvani thalis, solkadhi and more, checked by our team.
meta_map: Map of verified places, stays and food on the Konkan coast, with tide times, road alerts and trails. Works offline with downloaded taluka packs.
meta_taste: Konkan dishes worth travelling for — solkadhi, ukadiche modak, Malvani fish thali — and the verified places that make them best.
meta_itineraries: Ready-made Konkan trips by our team and by travellers: day-by-day stops, drive times and tide-safe timings to plan from.

privacy_ai_intro: Crabby is optional and needs sign-in. When you ask Crabby something, your message is processed by an AI model run by Groq, Inc. (USA). Crabby answers only from Crabwalk's own verified data.
privacy_ai_sent_1: Your message and the last few messages of the current chat (kept only in your browser tab).
privacy_ai_sent_2: Your saved preferences (diet, budget level, group type) and a short summary of your Crabby profile — only from the sources you switch on.
privacy_ai_sent_3: Public listing data Crabby looks up for you (names, hours, prices, ratings).
privacy_ai_never_1: Phone numbers — they are removed even if you type them.
privacy_ai_never_2: Your location or location history. Emergency messages never reach the AI.
privacy_ai_never_3: Your name, email or account id.
privacy_ai_never_4: Map or route data from our maps provider.
privacy_ai_staff: Our team uses AI to draft and translate listing text from verified facts (Google Gemini; no traveller data), to pre-screen reviews, and to write nightly review summaries (Groq). People make every final decision.
privacy_ai_limits: Crabwalk does not store your one-to-one chats with Crabby. We count messages per day (up to 20) and keep previews you apply or discard. Groq states it does not keep inference data by default.
privacy_p12_title: Group chat, photos, journal and your Crabby profile
privacy_p12_chat: Trip group chat is stored so your tripmates can read it, and deleted 30 days after the trip's last day (trips without dates: 30 days after the last message). Every message passes an automatic safety check. When Crabby helps in the chat, the AI gets the trip's last messages with names replaced by “Member 1, 2…”.
privacy_p12_profile: Your Crabby profile is built by our code from the sources you switch on in Me → Crabby & you (quiz, activity, chats, trips and QR scans). You can correct or delete any line, or reset it. Only a short summary reaches the AI.
privacy_p12_photos: Photos you send to Crabby (snap and ask, reel screenshots) are off until you switch them on. Your phone re-encodes them first, which removes location and camera data; our AI provider (Groq) looks at them and we don't store them. A reel link sends only the video's public title.
privacy_p12_journal: Journal photos and clips stay on your phone. A photo you add to your journal is stored (compressed) until you remove it. Your journal is private unless you turn on its share link; your answers go to the AI only when you ask Crabby to write your story.
privacy_p12_requests: Stay requests: the host or our team sees your dates, guests and budget. Your phone number is shared with the host only after you accept their answer.

privacy_s1_body: Crabwalk is a travel guide for the Konkan coast. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and your choices under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Contact and grievance officer: [name, email, postal address — to be added].
privacy_s2_body:
Account: your email (and name from Google if you sign in with Google), to sign you in.
Preferences you set: diet, budget level, group type, language and theme.
Trips you plan, and friends' votes (name they type) on trips you share.
Ratings, reviews and review photos you post; they are moderated before they appear.
Booking-proof screenshots, only to verify a stay or meal — deleted within 30 days.
Owner claims: email and the listing you claim, to verify ownership.
Problem reports, with no account needed.
QR scans: a random, hashed session id and your language; your position only if you have already allowed location.
privacy_s3_body: Location is used on your device for the map, navigation, live trips and the emergency card. We do not keep a location history. It leaves your device only when you: verify a visit at a QR plaque (we store the distance, not your position); search or navigate to a place that is not in Crabwalk while signed in (sent to Ola Maps through our server, not stored); or share your location from the emergency card (sent by you, to whoever you choose).
privacy_s4_body: In Me you can turn on or off at any time: anonymous visit times (stored with a random daily id, never your account), and leave-time reminders (push notifications; turning off deletes the subscription). Crabby (AI) is optional; see the AI section below. Offline packs and saved routes stay on your device.
privacy_s5_body: Supabase (database, sign-in, file storage; Mumbai region). Cloudflare (hosting and delivery). Groq (Crabby AI). Google Gemini (staff content drafting only — no traveller data). Ola Maps (search and directions for signed-in users). Google (only if you sign in with Google). Weather and tide data come from OpenWeatherMap and TideCheck; no personal data is sent to them. We do not sell personal data or use advertising trackers.
privacy_s6_body: Booking proofs: deleted after review, at most 30 days. Push subscriptions: until you turn reminders off. Anonymous visit times and QR scans: kept as anonymous statistics. Account, trips, ratings and reviews: while your account exists. To delete your account and its data, contact us at [email — to be added]; we act within [period — to be set].
privacy_s7_body: You can ask to access, correct or erase your personal data, withdraw any consent (as easily as you gave it), nominate someone to act for you, and raise a grievance with our grievance officer; if not resolved, you may approach the Data Protection Board of India. [Accounts for users under 18: parental consent process — to be decided by legal.]
privacy_s8_body: We will show the date of the last change at the top of this page and tell signed-in users about important changes in the app. Last updated: [date — set on publication].
